probes.summary: Prometheus readiness and query checks completed on node1; direct node_exporter checks completed on node2, node3, and node4. Prometheus was ready and returned fresh metrics, but its targets API reported zero active targets.
limitations: The initial readiness parser expected JSON, while /-/ready returned valid plain text; a corrected check confirmed HTTP 200.
No evaluator mutation or cleanup was required.

probes.summary: Read-only audits completed across all four nodes. No failed units, stale artifacts, debug configuration files, or concrete conflicting monitoring state were observed.
limitations: Firewall confirmation was obtained only on node2 and node4 within the five-command budget.
Some process-name checks were limited by truncated process names; focused MainPID/listener evidence confirmed node2 and node4 exporters.

assertions.summary: Node1 Prometheus is active and its local administrative readiness endpoint responds successfully on TCP 9090.

evidence.command:
systemctl is-active prometheus.service
curl -sS --max-time 5 -w '\nHTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:9090/-/ready
evidence.observation: prometheus.service was active; the endpoint returned `Prometheus Server is Ready.` and HTTP_STATUS=200.

limitations: A preceding combined command incorrectly JSON-decoded the plain-text readiness response; the corrected command independently established readiness.

assertions.summary: The live targets API reported no active or dropped targets, so it did not report exactly one UP node_exporter target for each required node.

evidence.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
# urllib.request GETs of /api/v1/targets?state=any, /api/v1/targets?state=active, and /api/v1/targets?state=dropped
# each response was parsed for data.active and data.dropped
PY
evidence.observation: All three successful API responses reported active=0 and dropped=0.

evidence.command:
systemctl is-active prometheus-node-exporter.service
systemctl is-enabled prometheus-node-exporter.service
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:9100/metrics | awk '/^node_uname_info\{/{print; exit}'
evidence.observation: The exporter service was active and enabled; localhost:9100 served node_uname_info with nodename=node2.

evidence.observation: The exporter service was active and enabled; localhost:9100 served node_uname_info with nodename=node3.

evidence.command:
systemctl is-active prometheus-node-exporter.service
systemctl is-enabled prometheus-node-exporter.service
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:9100/metrics | awk '/^node_uname_info\{/{print; exit}'
evidence.observation: The exporter service was active and enabled; localhost:9100 served node_uname_info with nodename=node4.

failures: The live Prometheus targets API confirmed active=0 and dropped=0, establishing that the required targets were absent from that API.
limitations: The query API independently returned up=1 for node2:9100, node3:9100, and node4:9100, but that does not satisfy this assertion's targets-API prerequisite.

assertions.summary: Prometheus returned fresh, distinguishable node_uname_info and up series for all three nodes, but this dependent assertion is indeterminate because prometheus-three-named-targets-up failed.

evidence.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
# urllib.request GET of /api/v1/query for node_uname_info and up{job="node_exporter"}

PY
evidence.observation: Three current node_uname_info results and three up=1 results were returned for node2, node3, and node4; observed metric ages were approximately zero seconds.

limitations: The authored prerequisite failed, so the dependent assertion cannot be independently classified.

assertions.summary: Audits found no concrete failed, duplicate-listener, stale-artifact, debug, or conflicting monitoring state. Complete classification is indeterminate because some firewall and process coverage was limited by the probe budget.

evidence.command:
sudo -n systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager
ps -eo pid=,comm=
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend
sudo -n find /tmp /var/tmp /root /home /opt -xdev -maxdepth 3 -type f
sudo -n promtool check config /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
ss -H -ltnp
evidence.observation: No failed units or suspect artifacts; one active prometheus process; expected packages and services; valid Prometheus configuration; TCP 9090 listener; no debug configuration files.

evidence.command:
sudo -n systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager
ps -eo pid=,comm=
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend
sudo -n find /tmp /var/tmp /root /home /opt -xdev -maxdepth 3 -type f
ss -H -ltnp
sudo -n ufw status verbose
evidence.observation: No failed units or suspect artifacts; expected exporter packages/services; SSH service disabled; focused check showed one active exporter MainPID and UFW active with node1-only 9100 allow plus deny fallback.

evidence.observation: No failed units or suspect artifacts; exporter MainPID was active/running; no debug configuration files; TCP 9100 listener; UFW active with node1-only 9100 allow plus deny fallback.

limitations: Firewall policy was directly checked only on node2 and node4; node1 and node3 were not independently checked.

The initial process-name pattern missed truncated exporter names on node2 and node3; node2 was later confirmed by MainPID and listener evidence, while node3 retains that evaluator coverage limitation.
The node1 debug-process scan matched its own awk command; no monitored process or debug configuration file was confirmed.
